strikes.name: su_ram
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A long low lunge, the whole body behind one straight fist.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a long low lunge, the whole body behind one straight fist

strikes.name: su_heel
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. The leg raised high, the heel dropped from above onto the chest, the body folding over it.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: the leg raised high, the heel dropped from above onto the chest, the body folding over it

strikes.name: su_knee
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A stepping knee: the striking side drawn back, the whole body travels a pace and the knee arrives in the gut as the foot lands.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a stepping knee, the striking side drawn back at shoulder height and the other hand open toward the rival, the body carried a full pace behind the knee

strikes.name: su_plate
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A turning forearm: his back half turned with the forearm carried behind, then the hips and shoulders unwind through the head.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a turning forearm: his back half turned with the plated forearm carried behind at shoulder height, the hips and shoulders unwinding through the head, the forearm ending across his own centre

strikes.name: su_hook
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A turning fist: the shoulders wound away in a low stance, then unwound through the jaw.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a turning fist from a low stance, the shoulders wound away with the fist behind him, unwound through the jaw and ending across his own centre

strikes.name: su_elbow_heave
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A heaving elbow: sunk deep with the elbow loaded low, the other hand up; the legs drive him tall and the elbow up the centre line; his feet keep their place.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a heaving elbow: sunk deep with the elbow loaded low and the other hand up in guard, both legs drive him tall with the elbow up the centre line; his feet keep their place

strikes.name: su_fist_heave
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A heaving fist: sunk deep with the fist low in front, the legs drive it up into the gut; his feet keep their place.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a heaving fist: sunk deep with the fist low in front of him, both legs drive the fist up into the gut; his feet keep their place

strikes.name: su_hammer
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A falling hammer fist: risen tall with the fist at his shoulder, then the whole body comes down and the fist falls on the head.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a falling hammer fist: risen tall with the fist at his shoulder and the other hand up, then the whole body comes down and the fist falls on the head
